Veterans Benefits: Massachusetts fully excludes U.S. military retirement pensions from state gross income. Eligible veterans may also receive local property-tax exemptions based on disability or qualifying service, with additional options under the state's HERO Act.
Description: Lexington is an affluent, historic Boston suburb (site of the first battle of the American Revolution) and home to MIT Lincoln Laboratory, a major Department of Defense R&D center with roughly 4,500 staff, on the Hanscom Air Force Base perimeter. Housing costs are extreme, violent and property crime are both well below the national average, and the town consistently ranks among the safest and best-educated communities in Massachusetts.
